title: Human replies label values and empty states; write receipts print what changed; --json prints everything.
verification: Routine replies use concise command-specific projections and pages. Write receipts print what changed; --json prints everything. Only oversized registered human reads refuse atomically above 28,000 UTF-8 bytes; the refusal names the field, filter, limit and paging flags that command really has and points to command help. List reads use --limit/--offset paging and explicitly name the next page when cut short. An oversized selected section lists only smaller headings when present and offers the same read with --full; without smaller headings, it says so and still gives that working retry.
